transcript.text: Last spring I kept bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai for work, and it felt like every other week I was on that route again.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I even tried the trains on that same Beijing–Shanghai run a couple times, just to see if it was less exhausting than flying.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker Mason White told me he’d already taken the G1 on 2025-03-13, and he said it was smooth door-to-door.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He also mentioned he’d gone with Second Class, which sounded totally fine for a daytime ride like that.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for flights, I remember He Xia’s ticket was MU5678 on 2025-05-06 with China Eastern—she said the whole thing was already sorted back then.
